cohort: 180 women who underwent a gentle caesarean section, 120 with fetuses in cephalic presentation and 60 with fetuses in breech presentation
finding: There was no clinically significant difference in maternal or neonatal outcome between cephalic and breech presentation when a gentle caesarean section was performed.
mod_finding: Gentle caesarean section appears to be safe for breech presentation, with no clinically significant difference in maternal or neonatal outcome compared to cephalic presentation.
birth_weight: Lower in the breech presentation group
